services.license: Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service or Adobe Commerce Optimizer

source.title: Experience League: Commerce Storefront and Adobe Experience Platform

connection_how: The Adobe Commerce storefront runs on Edge Delivery Services, which serves pages and storefront code while drop-ins request catalog and shopping data from the configured services. Commerce as a Cloud Service supplies both; with Commerce Optimizer, catalog services come from Optimizer while the existing platform handles cart, checkout, accounts and orders. product_facts: Edge Delivery Services is Adobe's content delivery framework, a core part of Adobe Experience Manager, built for speed, simplicity and scalability. It works with your own CDN or the included Adobe-managed CDN.
Edge Delivery Services delivers the site's pages, built for speed.
We would build the site on Edge Delivery Services with its code managed and deployed directly from a GitHub repository. New content is added instantly, without a rebuild process.

Every project on Edge Delivery Services should produce a Lighthouse score of 100 for mobile and desktop, measured with Google PageSpeed Insights. Adobe's guidance is that the score is not hard to keep at 100 with continuous testing, so we would test each change.

Your authors can work in AEM Authoring, which includes Document Authoring and AEM Sites Author, or in Microsoft SharePoint or Google Drive. They get an instant URL to see their content changes and share them with others for review.

For your existing site, Adobe's importer automates importing and converting multiple pages. We would make example imports of each page type so your authors can confirm the structure, and reflect retired URLs in the redirects spreadsheet.

services.name: Commerce Data Connection to Platform
services.scope: Configure the Commerce Services connector and Data Connection, create the schema, datasets and datastream, turn on storefront, back office and profile data, and check the first events. For an Edge Delivery storefront, storefront events reach Experience Platform through the storefront's own settings (the Storefront events to Experience Platform service, where included); confirm how back office and profile data flow for the deployment.
services.adobe_quote: you must configure both connectors, starting with the Commerce Services connector then finishing with the Data Connection extension

source.title: Experience League: Connect Commerce data to Adobe Experience Platform

connection_how: The Data Connection extension sends Commerce storefront, back office and profile data to Experience Platform, and Audience Activation brings Real-Time CDP audiences back into Commerce (Commerce on Cloud or on-premises; Real-Time CDP Prime or Ultimate).
product_facts: Real-Time CDP brings known and anonymous data from your systems together into customer profiles, builds audiences from them and activates those audiences across channels.
Real-Time CDP brings known and anonymous customer data together into profiles and builds the audiences.
A customer becomes known when they sign in: the site sends a person-level identifier, such as a CRM ID or a hashed email, with the visit, and Experience Platform stitches it into their profile.
Real-Time CDP's Adobe Target destination makes those audiences available to Target for same-page and next-page personalization, with governance and privacy support, using a datastream.

Consent and data-use rules travel with the data: the Web SDK sends or discards data according to each visitor's consent, and Experience Platform enforces the data usage policies you enable when audiences are activated. We would keep sensitive attributes out of those audiences unless you approve them, and never use personalization to decide eligibility or pricing.

Adobe Commerce is Adobe's B2B and B2C commerce platform for digital commerce experiences across online and physical spaces. Its Admin gives your team marketing, search engine optimization and product management tools.

product_facts: Marketo Qualifier is Adobe's app for business development representatives: its Account Qualification Agent analyzes your accounts and prospects, prioritizes those that are ready for the next step, and drafts personalized outreach based on your CRM data.
Marketo Qualifier prioritizes the accounts and prospects for your business development representatives and drafts their outreach.

Once Adobe provisions Marketo Qualifier, we would create the user groups and connect Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365 with your CRM administrator, then map the inbound fields. The first connection needs read-only access; activity synchronization and opt-out write-back need write access.

In an Outbound Workflow your team defines the goal and targeting criteria; AI proposes a multitouch cadence and writes personalized email content for each prospect, using your sales materials in the Knowledge Center. No email is sent until the prospect's owner approves it.

Brand Concierge hands a conversation to a person through live chat or meeting booking, keeping the context the visitor already provided. Both route through Marketo Qualifier, where your representatives connect their calendars, set their availability and take chats; the first representative to accept takes it.

Marketo Qualifier reports on outbound activity and results across your team, and by Outbound Workflow campaign on active prospects, open rate, click rate, reply rate and meetings booked. With activity sync on, your representatives see the outreach activities in the CRM.

product_facts: Journey Optimizer is Adobe's application for creating and delivering connected, personalized customer experiences across your channels. It is built on Adobe Experience Platform and its real-time customer profile, and runs both real-time journeys and scheduled campaigns.
Journey Optimizer orchestrates the journeys and campaigns and delivers the messages across channels.

We would set Journey Optimizer up in the order Adobe documents: the environment first, with a development sandbox for building and testing and a production sandbox for sending, each with its own channel configurations. Journeys are tested with test profiles before activation.

A journey automates a real-time, multi-step sequence of interactions; a campaign sends a scheduled or API-triggered message to an audience. Messages are delivered through channels like email, mobile messages, push notifications and direct mail.
Journey Optimizer tracks customer engagement and campaign performance with reports, and its reporting is integrated with Customer Journey Analytics for a clearer view of performance metrics.

When messages are sent from journeys or campaigns, your customers must always be able to unsubscribe; once they do, their profiles are automatically removed from the audience of future marketing messages. Access labels control which users can reach specific journeys, campaigns and channel configurations.

services.name: Warehouse tables into CJA
services.scope: For the agreed tables: confirm with the Client's data team that change tracking is on for each table, create the relational schemas (a primary key and a version, plus a timestamp for event data), set up the Experience Platform source with change data capture (Data Mirror), map the fields and set the schedule, add the datasets to the CJA connection (the existing connection, or the one Connections, data views and stitching sets up) with their join, and add their fields to the data view.

source.title: Experience League: CJA and Data Mirror

services.template_deliverable: Synced datasets for the agreed tables in the CJA connection and data view, with a mapping record.
services.template_acceptance: Record counts in CJA match the warehouse for an agreed day, and an update and a delete made in the warehouse show in CJA after the next sync.
services.template_assumptions:
The Client has CJA Select, Prime or Ultimate (Data Mirror is not in CJA Foundation). The Client's data team gives the access the source needs (for Google BigQuery, a dataset for temporary tables; for Azure Databricks, a SAS token in the cluster's Spark configuration), allows Adobe's IP addresses where the warehouse needs it and turns on change tracking for each table (each warehouse has its own setting). Mirrored changes count toward the CJA ingestion limit. Other warehouses, such as Amazon Redshift or Azure Synapse Analytics, need separately licensed source connectors without Data Mirror, and a service of their own. On Experience Platform running on AWS, the sources are Google BigQuery and Snowflake, not Azure Databricks. When CJA data preparation in Experience Platform is also in this SOW, this service covers only the work that service does not.

Use the CDC datasets created for CJA Data Mirror for CJA analysis; do not reuse them directly as RTCDP or Journey Optimizer datasets. Scope alternative datasets for those applications separately. CJA Audience Publishing can separately activate audiences derived from the mirrored data. Relational schemas used for Data Mirror cannot be enabled for Real-Time Customer Profile or Identity Service. At setup, the Client and partner assign responsibility for per-field governance labels, source-table deletions propagated through CDC, and corresponding hygiene/privacy requests for downstream identity-bearing datasets.
services.template_exclusions: Changes to the Client's warehouse or tables (the Client turns on change tracking), licenses, and new CJA connections or data views.
services.template_basis: Up to five tables from one Snowflake, Google BigQuery or Azure Databricks warehouse, through Data Mirror.

product_facts: There are two documented routes. The simpler one: forms built in Marketo Engage are embedded on the site's pages with Marketo's own embed code, so each submission is a Marketo form fill. We would place the embed in a reusable page component, agree the fields, consent wording and validation with you, and collect only the data you approve. Marketo's form prefill does not work with the embed code.

The fuller one: AEM Forms adaptive forms with the Submit to Marketo Engage action, which add a rule editor, prefill and a PDF record of each submission, and can connect to Adobe Sign for e-signatures. We would use embedded Marketo forms for standard lead capture and adaptive forms where a form needs that logic.
Marketo Engage is Adobe's marketing automation platform, a single solution that lets you attract, segment and nurture your customers. Each marketing initiative runs as a program.
Marketo Engage runs the marketing programs that attract, segment and nurture your customers.

We would configure the admin settings, including CNAMEs and Marketo's JavaScript tracking code, Munchkin, which tracks the people who visit your website so that automated campaigns can react to their visits. We would test the automation workflows and the data sync before launch.
Campaigns run as Smart Campaigns. A Smart List defines who you want to target, using filters and triggers, and the flow sets the steps the campaign performs, including wait steps and split choices.

product_facts: Workfront is Adobe's suite of cloud-based applications for planning, project management, collaboration and resource management. It organizes, prioritizes, tracks and manages both your work and your resources.
Workfront organizes, prioritizes, tracks and manages the work and its resources.

We would set up request queues, so every request is submitted the same way and follows the same path to completion, with routing rules that send each one to a user, job role, team or project, and project templates that capture your repeatable processes.
Reviews and approvals can be one-time or come from reusable approval templates, with multi-stage approvals and parallel paths, and comprehensive audit logging keeps a complete governance trail.
Workfront organizes information in reports, places multiple reports on a dashboard and lets you share both reports and dashboards with others.
Access is governed at two levels: your Workfront administrator sets the access levels, and within those levels people share objects with view, contribute or manage permissions.

product_facts: Firefly Creative Production is Adobe's enterprise offering for scaled content automation. It brings together workflow authoring, headless creative services and a production runtime to produce on-brand outputs at scale, for work such as campaign variants, localization and templated asset production.
Firefly Creative Production produces on-brand outputs at scale through reusable workflows.

We would turn your existing production playbook into reusable workflows: define the inputs, assemble the steps, add logic and test the flow, then link it to your source systems, review tools and storage locations so that it fits into your existing environment.

The Workflow API executes published workflows across multiple assets in one batch. Your external platforms can trigger workflow executions, with processed outputs returned to the originating environment, and Firefly Services APIs cover headless and programmatic use cases.

Your admin assigns access in the Admin Console. Workflow authoring and admin access can stay with a smaller group of specialists, while a broader group runs the published workflows, guided experiences, APIs or bulk actions.

Teams monitor progress and review results on each run, focusing attention on exceptions rather than on every asset. The Workflow API returns batch status with asset counts, execution statistics and estimated time remaining.

services.adobe_quote: which let you pull content from services such as Adobe Cloud Storage and Frame.io when available in your environment

source.title: Adobe Firefly help: Use input and output nodes

product_facts: Frame.io is where your creative teams and their stakeholders organize, review and manage creative assets as they move from ideation to final approval.
Frame.io is where creative assets are organized, reviewed and managed on their way to final approval.

Reviewers and approvers add comments, mark up the asset and make the approval decision in the Frame.io viewer, which provides version history and comparison and time-stamped comments for video reviews.

Each user has an account role, assigned in the Adobe Admin Console, that sets their baseline permissions: Content Admins have administrative access to all public resources, and Members need an explicit invitation to reach a project or workspace.
Frame.io has a REST API and webhooks for custom workflows and automations, and server-to-server authentication integrates it with your other tools without relying on individual user accounts.

Firefly Creative Production is Adobe's enterprise offering for scaled content automation. It brings together workflow authoring, headless creative services and a production runtime to produce on-brand outputs at scale, for work such as campaign variants, localization and templated asset production.

product_facts: AEM Assets as a Cloud Service is Adobe's cloud-native solution for digital asset management and Dynamic Media. It helps you maximize the value of your digital assets across creation, management and delivery.
AEM Assets is the repository where your digital assets are managed, enriched and delivered.

To bring your existing library across, Bulk Import lets administrators import large numbers of assets directly from an external data source in a single operation. AEM applies smart tags to uploaded assets automatically, by default.

People find the right asset through smart tags, customized metadata and enhanced search. Metadata forms let you add your own business-specific fields to an asset's details page, and we would agree those fields with you before the assets are loaded.
For distribution, Content Hub centralizes and distributes approved brand and marketing content. Only assets marked Approved in AEM Assets become available there.
Asset reports show how the system is used, how users interact with assets and which assets are shared.
